items.stem: An attacker phishes a user, lands on an endpoint, then moves to a server. In Defender XDR, how is this best viewed?

options.text: As a single incident with a cross-domain attack story across email, endpoint and identity
options.rationale: Correct: XDR correlates signals into one incident.

options.text: As four unrelated alerts in separate products
options.rationale: XDR exists to correlate these, not silo them.
That misses the email and identity stages.
It is a security incident, not billing.

items.explanation: Correct: XDR correlates signals into one incident.
